items.definition:
providing nourishment; healthy
Eating nutritious food is essential for good health.

without sleep; unable to sleep
She spent a sleepless night worrying about the exam.

not supervised or looked after
Never leave your luggage unattended.

wearing a uniform
The uniformed officers stood guard.

able to bounce well; lively and cheerful
The children loved playing with the bouncy ball.

easily set on fire
Gasoline is a highly flammable liquid.

having many hills
The countryside around here is very hilly.

relating to Jordan or its people
She met a Jordanian student at the university.

loose-fitting
He was wearing a baggy t-shirt.

able to be downloaded
The software update is now downloadable from our website.

without pain
The dentist assured me the procedure would be painless.

easily annoyed or irritated; bad-tempered
The baby was cranky because he hadn't had his nap.

having curves; shapely
The road was very curvy as it wound through the mountains.

able to be moved
The furniture was easily movable.

Full of or lit by stars
We gazed up at the starry night sky.

inviting hugs or snuggling
The puppy was very soft and cuddly.

Without a job; unemployed
The government is trying to reduce the number of jobless people.

wet and soft, typically unpleasantly so
The rain made the ground soggy and muddy.

not planned or arranged in advance
We had an unplanned stop due to a flat tire.

not wanted or welcome
His presence at the party was unwelcome.

not well; ill
She felt unwell after eating too much.

somewhat brown in color
The old photograph had a yellowish-brownish tint.

unable to be separated or treated separately
The two friends were inseparable.

swollen, soft, and rounded
Her eyes were puffy from crying all night.

having or showing skill
She is a very skillful painter.

containing or tasting like sugar
The drink was too sugary for my taste.

relating to Bavaria, a state in Germany
He enjoyed traditional Bavarian cuisine.

Without a score; having no points.
The first half of the game remained scoreless.

Absolutely clean or pure.
The kitchen was absolutely spotless after she cleaned it.

Having a strong, unpleasant smell.
The garbage can was very stinky.

Relating to Latvia, its people, or its language
She is learning the Latvian language.

having a sharp or tapered end
The witch wore a tall, pointy hat.

not wearing a shirt
He walked around the beach shirtless.

relating to Argentina or its people
She loves Argentinian tango music.

relating to Estonia, its people, or its language
She is learning Estonian to communicate with her relatives.

sudden and uneven
The old car made a jerky stop.

cozy, comfortable
The cat found a snug spot by the fireplace.

athletic, stylishly casual
She likes to wear sporty clothes when she goes hiking.

relating to Asia or its peoples
The Asiatic lion is an endangered species.

relating to Flanders, its people, or their language
He speaks Flemish fluently.

Solitary or lonely.
He felt lonesome after his friends left.

Relating to Mongolia, its people, or its language.
She is studying Mongolian history.

full of or producing steam; hot and humid
The bathroom was steamy after her hot shower.

foolish or imprudent
It would be unwise to invest all your money in one stock.

covered in or resembling slime; unpleasantly thick and slippery
The slug left a slimy trail on the pavement.

feeling as if you are about to vomit
The smell of the food made me feel nauseous.

approaching; coming nearer
She had to swerve to avoid the oncoming car.

Shining with many small flashes of light.
She wore a sparkly dress to the party.

Making a short, high-pitched sound or series of sounds.
The old door had a squeaky hinge.

without children
The couple remained childless throughout their lives.

having a leak
The leaky faucet dripped all night.

not clean; dirty; morally or ritually impure.
The water was unclean and unsafe to drink.

possible to do; feasible
The task seems difficult, but it's definitely doable.

traveling or leading towards the east
The eastbound train was delayed by an hour.

having feathers
The bird had beautiful feathered wings.

covered with clouds
The sky was overcast, threatening rain.

used; not new
She bought a secondhand car that was still in good condition.

tiny; very small
She found a teeny tiny spider on the wall.

not good enough; failing to satisfy
His performance at work was deemed unsatisfactory.

not having or requiring special skill or training
The factory hired many unskilled laborers.

made of wool; unclear or confused
She wore a warm, woolly hat.

hard to please; overly concerned with minor details
He's very fussy about his food and won't eat anything green.

squishy (soft, wet, and easily compressible)
The mud was very squishy after the heavy rain.

without a date
The old letter was undated, making it hard to place in time.
